spans.s:
निर_क्ष (क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
a. Without dice or
latitude.
m. Equator.

नि-रञ्जन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Without pas-
sion; unstained.
f. The day of
full moon.
n. God.

निर_न्तर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Coarse; con-
tinued; identical; unbounded;
unconcealed.

निर_न्तरा-भ्यास (सः) 1.
m. Private stu-
dy; diligent pursuit.

निर_न्वय (यः-या-यं)
a. Childless; un-
connected, unmethodical.

निर_पवर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. Absence of re-
turn; or of a common measure.

निर_र्थक (कः-का-कं)
a. Vain, fruit-
less, unmeaning.

निर_सन (नं) 1.
n. Rejection, deni-
al; spitting out; killing.

निरा_सन (नं) 1.
n. Rejection; kil-
ling; spitting out.

निर-स (सः-सा-सं)
a. Dry, insipid.
m.
Want of juice; insipidity.

निरा_स (सः) 1.
m. Expelling; op-
posing; abandoning.

नी-रस (सः) 1.
m. The pomegranate.
a. Dry, withered, insipid.

निर_स्त (स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
a. Shot as an ar-
row; uttered rapidly; thrown;
abandoned; rejected.

निरस्त-विषय (यः-या-यं)
a. Indifferent
to the things of the world.

निर_हङ्कार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Humble. Also
निरहङ्कृत, निरहङ्कृति, निरहङ्क्रिय.

निरा_कार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Without form
or figure.
m. Heaven,
Viṣṇu;
Shiva; God; reproach.

निरा_कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Removed,
opposed; despised, rejected.

निरा_कृति (तिः) 2.
f. Rejection; op-
position, obstacle.
a. Without
form; one who has not gone
through a due course of study.

निरा_चार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Lawless, cor-
rupt, depraved; barbarian.

निरा_देश (शः) 1.
m. Delivery, pay-
ment, discharge.

निरा_मय (यः-या-यं)
a. Well, hale.
m.
A wild goat; a hog, boar.

निरा_मिषा-शिन् (शी-शिनी-शि)
a. Liv-
ing without flesh, temperate.

निरा_लम्व (म्वः-म्वा-म्वं)
a. Self-sup-
ported, not relying on others.

निरी_क्षण (णं) 1.
n. Looking at; re-
garding; expecting.

निरी_श (शं) 1.
n. The body of a plough.

निरु_क्त (क्तं) 1.
n. A glossary of the
Vedas; derivation.
a. Said; ob-
scure; obsolete.

निरु_त्तर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Without an
answer, speechless.

निरुद्ध-प्रकश (शः) 1.
m. Stricture of
the urethra.

निरु_द्विग्न (ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
a. Free from
alarm, quiet, sedate.

निरु_पद्रव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Free from
oppression, or distress.

निरु_पप्लव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Free from
trouble or alarm.

नि-रूढ (ढः-ढा-ढं)
a. Current (mean-
ing); inherent; unmarried.
m.
Common acceptation of words.

निरू-ढमन् (मा) 5.
m. Currency of
meaning, acknowledged^1 sense.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

नि-रूपणीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Fit to be look-
ed for, discussed or appointed.

नि-रूपित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Seen; ascer-
tained; considered; appointed.

नि-रूह (हः) 1.
m. A complete sen-
tence; certainty; logic; enema.

नि-रृति (तिः-तिः-ति)
a. Free from
violence.
m. A demi-god.
f. Ca-
lamity; security.

नि-र्गन्धन (नं) 1.
n. Killing, slaugh-
ter, injury.

निर्गन्ध-पुष्पी (ष्पी) 3.
f. The
simul or
silk-cotton tree.

नि-र्गम (मः) 1.
m. Exit; loss, depar-
ture. Also निर्गमन, निर्गति.

नि-र्गुण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Void of all pro-
perties; bad.
m. God.

निर्गुणत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Freedom from all
the passions peculiar to mortals.

निर्गुण्डी (ण्डी) 3.
f. A shrub, Vitex
negundo; root of the lotus.

नि-र्गूढ (ढः) 1.
m. The hollow of a tree.

नि-र्ग्रन्थ (न्थः) 1.
m. A sage or devotee,
a mendicant; idiot; gambler.

निर्ग्रन्थक (कः) 1.
m. A religious men-
dicant; a gambler.
a. Unattend-
ed; deserted; clever.

नि-र्घट (टं) 1.
n. A great collection
of people, a fair, a market.

नि-र्घात (तः) 1.
m. A gust of wind,
a whirlwind; a rumbling sound.

नि-र्जन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Lonely, unpeo-
pled, desolate, void.

नि-र्जर (रः) 1.
m. A deity.
f. A plant
or perfume.
n. Ambrosia.
a. Im-
mortal, undecaying.

निर्जिते_न्द्रिय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of subdu-
ed senses, feelings or passions.

नि-र्झर (रः) 1.
m. A cascade or tor-
rent.
m. Horse of the sun; fire
of chaff.
f. (री) A river.

निर्झरिन् (री) 5.
m. A mountain.
f.
(रिणी) A river.

नि-र्णर (रः) 1.
m. A horse of the sun.

नि-र्णेतृ (ता-त्री-तृ)
a. Certifying.
m.
A judge; a voucher; a guide.

नि-र्दग्ध (ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
a. Burnt, con-
sumed; unburnt.

नि-र्दट (टः-टा-टं)
a. Unkind; unne-
cessary; envious; mad.

नि-र्दर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Harsh; shame-
less.
n. Pith.
adv. Excessively.

निर्दरि-वासिन् (सी-सिनी-सि)
a. Inha-
biting a cave. 5.
m. A hermit.

नि-र्दहन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Without burn-
ing.
m. The marking nut.

नि-र्दारित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Torn, opened,
staring, starting (the eyes).

नि-र्दिष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Described,
shewn; ordered; assigned.

नि-र्देष्टृ (ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
a. Explaining,
shewing.
m. A teacher, guide.

नि-र्द्वन्द्व (न्द्वः-न्द्वा-न्द्वं)
a. Simple; nei-
ther glad nor sorry, stoical; not
embracing two principles.

नि-र्धन (नः) 1.
m. An old ox.
a. Poor.

नि-र्धार (रः) 1.
m. Certainty; the de-
termining of merit.

नि-र्धार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
a. Acting fear-
lessly; active; ascertainable.

नि-र्धूत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Deserted; re-
jected by friends; refuted.

नि-र्नाथ (थः-था-थं)
a. Without a mas-
ter, protector, or superior.

निर्ब्बुद्धि^1 (द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
a. Foolish.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160315. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/252. note: 'rDi' is wrong. 'vv' should be 'bb' - but yat is careless about b/v..

नि-र्भर (रं) 1.
n. Pith, essence.
a. Much;
fearless.
adv. Excessively.

नि-र्भिन्न-हृदय (यः-या-यं)
a. Cut to the
heart; broken-hearted.

नि-र्म्मद (दः) 1.
m. An elephant out
of rut.
a. Sober, quiet.

नि-र्म्मन्थन (नं) 1.
n. Churning; sepa-
rating, discriminating.

नि-र्म्मल (लं) 1.
n. Remains of an of-
fering; talc.
a. Pure, clean.

नि-र्म्माण (णं) 1.
n. Manufacture, mak-
ing; pith, essence; fitness.

नि-र्म्माल्य (ल्यं) 1.
n. Remains of an
offering; purity.
f. (ल्या) A medi-
cinal plant.
a. Clean, pure.

नि-र्म्मित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Made, fabri-
cated, manufactured.

नि-र्म्मुक्त (क्तः) 1.
m. A snake that has
lately cast his skin.
a. Loosed.

नि-र्म्मुट (टः) 1.
m. A tree bearing
apparent blossoms; the sun; a
rogue.
n. A fair or market.

नि-र्म्मूल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Without root
or foundation; eradicated.

नि-र्म्मोक (कः) 1.
m. The slough of a
snake; liberating; armour; sky.

नि-र्य्याण (णं) 1.
n. Going out issue;
travelling; final; the outer cor-
ner of an elephant's eye; beati-
tude; tether for cattle.

नि-र्य्युक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Disunion; unfit-
ness; want of connexion.

नि-र्य्यूह (हः) 1.
m. A chaplet; a de-
coction; a door; a bracket.

नि-र्य्योग-क्षेम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Careless
about money or property.

नि-र्लिप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
p. Unanointed;
undefiled.
m. Krishna; a sage.

नि-र्लेप (पः-पा-पं)
a. Anointed; un-
defiled.
m. A sage.

नि-र्व्वचन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Silent.
n. Ex-
planation; index.

नि-र्व्वर्णण (णं) 1.
n. Gift; funeral
gift; extinguishing.

नि-र्व्वयनी (नी) 3.
f. Slough of a snake.

नि-र्व्वहण (णं-णा) 1.
n. f. Complet-
ing; supporting; catastrophe.

नि-र्व्वाच्य (च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
a. Improper to
be said; blameless.

नि-र्व्वाण (णं) 1.
n. External happiness
or absorption; extinction.
a. Li-
berated; extinct; dead; set (as
a planet); without arrows.

नि-र्व्वात (तः-ता-तं)
a. Calm.
m. A calm.

नि-र्व्वार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
a. Acting fear-
lessly; irresistible.

नि-र्व्वासन (नं) 1.
n. Killing; hurt-
ing; banishment.

नि-र्व्वास्य (स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
a. That ought
to be banished or expelled.

नि-र्व्वाहक (कं) 1.
n. Connection be-
tween cause and effect.

नि-र्व्विकल्पक (कं) 1.
n. Inherent or
intuitive knowledge.

नि-र्व्विघ्न (घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं)
a. Unobstructed.
n. Absence of impediment.
adv.
Freely, unobstructedly.

नि-र्व्विण्ण (ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
a. Desponding,
overcome with fear; humble.

नि-र्व्विण्ण-चेतस् (ताः-ताः-तः)
a. Resign-
ed, meek, humble.

नि-र्व्विवेक (कः-का-कं)
a. Undiscrimi-
nating, foolish, vain.

नि-र्व्विशेष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Same, not
different, indiscriminate.

नि-र्व्विषय (यः-या-यं)
a. Indifferent
to the things of the world.

नि-र्व्विष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
p. Arrived at;
got; engaged in; earned; mar-
ried; received; staying.

नि-र्व्वीर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Unheroic, cow-
ardly.
f. A childless widow.

नि-र्वृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Ended; free
from; happy. 1.
n. A house.

नि-र्वृति (तिः) 2.
f. Final absorption,
death, happiness; repose; set-
ting; cessation; completion.

नि-र्वृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Satisfaction; final
beatitude; approach; comple-
tion.
a. Destitute of employ.

नि-र्वेद (दः) 1.
m. Humility; expe-
rience of neglect; indifference.

नि-र्वेद-वादिन् (दी-दिनी-दि)
a. Ex-
pressing regret, complaining.

नि-र्वेश (शः) 1.
m. Engaging in;
attaining; wages; eating; en-
joyment; fainting.

नि-र्वेष्टन (नं) 1.
n. A small reed used
by weavers as a shuttle.

नि-र्व्यलीक (कः-का-कं)
a. Without
vanity, or deceit; true.

नि-र्व्यूढ (ढः-ढा-ढं)
a. Abandoned,
left; ended, completed.

नि-र्हरण (णं) 1.
n. Removing; tak-
ing the dead to be burnt.

नि-र्हार (रः) 1.
m. Extracting; evacua-
tion; burning, giving away; fra-
grance; accumulation of wealth.

नी-र (रं) 1.
n. Water; liquor; a juice.

नी-र-ज (जं) 1.
n. A sort of costus;
a lotus.
m. An otter.
a. Aquatic.

नी-रजस् (जाः-जाः-जः)
a. Free from
dust, pollen, or menstruation.

नीर-द (दः-दा-दं)
a. Toothless.
m. A cloud.

नी-राजन (नं-ना) 1.
n. f. Lustration of
arms; waving light to an idol.

नी-रुप (पः-पा-पं)
a. Shapeless.
m.
Wind; God.
n. Heaven, æther.
